clips.title: The story
paras: At Grimtotem Post, Grundig Darkcloud leads the Grimtotem force that sacked Makaba Flathoof's home. After you strike down the ruffians and mercenaries, Makaba sends you after Grundig and his brutes.

Makaba Flathoof survived the assault on his settlement along the Stonetalon trail, but his grief is still raw. After you prove yourself against Grimtotem foot soldiers, he points you toward Grundig Darkcloud, the one behind the bloodshed. Grundig commands a devoted band of brutes and led the slaughter that leveled the village.

Grundig camps at Grimtotem Post, farther up the mountain road to the west. To avenge Makaba's kin and protect the pass from more violence, you climb to the stronghold, fight through Grundig's brutes, and kill him before his raiders can descend on other vulnerable camps.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, you've done a fine job killing Grimtotem. If you dare, Grundig Darkcloud and his personal band of brutes is by far the worst of the lot. He was the one who led the brutal attack on my village.
You will find him in Grimtotem Post a bit further up the path to the west. Kill him, and I will be forever grateful.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you killed Grundig Darkcloud and his personal band of Brutes?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Grundig Darkcloud is dead! Friend, I will always be grateful for what you've done here today.
